rows.doc: Entries an NPC keeps; the rest fold into its summary (GDD 4.18).
Salience lost per world day.
What a player did to the NPC decays at this share of the rate.
Gossip is heard at this share of its salience.
A daily route's longest loop.
How far from home a route wanders.
A route stands this long; the NPC's next meeting after it measures the road and lays the route afresh (GDD 4.18).
Topics a meeting shows at most.
A topic this salient about a player queues a visit.
Entering a road or a populated tile meets a wanderer this often.
An NPC nobody meets for this long goes dormant.
News reaches an NPC from facts this close to home.
Memory entries a dossier carries.
Salience of a fight won beside an NPC.
Salience of a sale at an NPC's market.
Structures built in a region count towards crowding for this long (GDD 4.18).
A resident free to go moves home this often each time building leaves its settlement's region crowded.
How far a moving NPC looks for a quieter settlement, or failing one a quieter tile.
The nearest a moving NPC settles on open ground when no quieter settlement is in range.
Salience of a neighbour moving away.
